prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish hint changes have shown no clear effect across 3 tests.
Adoption redesign changes have shown no clear effect or performed worse across 2 tests.
Predictions were consistently too high across all round 1 tests.
Evidence is still thin for sign_in reorder, sign_in copy, home redesign, home new_flow, home wait_info, choose_path copy, and choose_path redesign changes as only one test has been completed for each.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Waiting screen preview sub-flow: Adds an interactive companion preview sub-screen while waiting for pet generation to keep users engaged during long rendering times. (why: The waiting step (home) has a median wait of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to significant drop-off before finishing onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, redesign] Compact mascot sign-in redesign: Redesigns the sign-in screen into a compact card layout with mascot reassurance about cloud saving. (why: Support receives 8 complaints about missing or reset pets after signing back in, and 76% conversion indicates friction.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move sign-in after pet rendering wait: Moves sign-in screen to occur right after pet rendering completes, right before the final intro. (why: Allowing pet creation and rendering to finish first reduces early drop-off and lets users feel ownership before creating an account.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting screen timer and progress indicators: Enables explicit time estimates and step progress counter on the rendering wait screen. (why: High median wait time (201s) causes uncertainty; showing explicit progress manages user expectations.)
4: [choose_path, new_screen] Pre-path overview intro screen: Inserts a short overview screen explaining what desktop pets do before asking users to choose a path. (why: High mean time on path selection (514s) indicates users lack context about how the app works.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop tray display shortcut hint: Adds a high-visibility hint on home_intro detailing how to recall the pet if it disappears. (why: Support received 3 emails about pets not showing on desktop or apps failing to open.)
6: [adoption, layout] Centered photo upload layout with guidance: Changes photo upload screen to a centered layout with clear photography guidelines. (why: Support logged 3 issues where custom pet generation failed or produced corrupted visuals.)
